properties.description: A pipeline run failed. Covers both pl_extract_to_landing and pl_master_etl_pipeline, scheduled or manual. Sev 1: the medallion is stale for that subject until the run is repeated. Window and frequency are both 1h. The first version evaluated a 15-minute window every 5 minutes with autoMitigate on, so three real failures produced a fired/resolved pair roughly every 45 minutes as the same events rolled in and out of the window — alert fatigue from a handful of events. Matching the two means each window is evaluated once.
